title: GOD, ARISE AND DEFEND ME AGAINST EVERY UNSEEN ENEMY
text: If you're watching this, I want you to do me a favor right now. Share this prayer. Share it with somebody. There's someone in your family. There's someone in your network. There's someone God has connected to you that needs to hear this word and partake of this prayer. The Holy Ghost is about to minister something powerful. And you don't want to be selfish with what heaven is about to release. Share it now. send it forward because what God is about to do in the next few minutes will shift atmospheres and break the conspiracy of darkness. I want us to go into the place of prayer this morning with a consciousness that the God we serve is not a passive God. He's not a God that sits down and watches while the enemy orchestrates evil against his children. The Bible says in Psalm 68:1, "Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him. Now I want you to understand something about this scripture. It is not suggesting that God is sleeping or that God is sitting somewhere inactive. When the scripture says let God arise, it is invoking the judicial intervention of heaven. It is calling forth the militant aspect of God's personality. It is summoning the God who is a man of war. The God who fights for his people. The God who breaks the teeth of the wicked. The God who frustrates the tokens of liars and makes diviners mad. There is a dimension of prayer where you are not just asking God for provision. You are not just asking God for breakthrough. You are invoking the warrior nature of Jehovah. You are calling upon Jehovah ni the Lord our banner who goes before us in battle. You are summoning Jehovah Sabbath, the Lord of Hosts, who commands the armies of heaven. And this morning, we're going to pray from that jurisdiction. We are going to pray from the place where heaven invades the conspiracy of hell. We're going to pray from the place where the enemies you don't even see, the enemies that are walking in the secret, the enemies that have gathered in covens and in darkness to orchestrate your downfall. We are going to command God to arise against them. Now listen to me very carefully. There are visible enemies and there are invisible enemies. There are enemies you can see with your physical eyes. And there are enemies that operate from the realm of the spirit. The Bible makes us understand in Ephesians 6:12 that we wrestle not against flesh and blood but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. The greatest battles you will ever fight are not the ones you see with your natural eyes. The greatest warfare is in the unseen realm. There are altars speaking against you. There are covenants fighting your destiny. There are ancestral powers monitoring [music] your progress. There are marine spirits assigned to trouble your marriage, to truncate your business, to scatter your peace, to bring confusion into your home. But I have come to announce to you this morning that the same God who delivered Israel from Egypt, the same God who parted the Red Sea, the same God who brought down the walls of Jericho, the same God who killed Goliath through David, the same God who shut the mouth of lions in the den with Daniel, that same God is alive today and he's still in the business of defending his children. When God arises, no enemy can stand. When God steps into the situation, the council of the wicked is frustrated. When God shows up, the trap that was set for you becomes the trap that consumes your enemy. I want you to understand the theology of divine defense. God does not just protect you passively. God defends you militantly. There is a difference between protection and defense. Protection is when God shields you from the arrow. Defense is when God goes after the one who shot the arrow. Defense is when God not only stops the plan, but embarrasses the planner. Defense is when God turns your case into a public testimony that will make hell regrets the day they touched you. This is what we're praying for this morning. Divine defense, militant intervention, heaven's aggressive justice on your behalf. Now, I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are. Whether you are in your room, whether you are in your car, whether you are at work, I want you to lift up your hands and begin to pray with me. We're going to engage in militant prayer. We're going to engage in prophetic intercession. We're going to invoke the God who does not slumber nor sleep. We're going to summon the God who is the judge of [music] all the earth. And I want you to pray with violence. Pray with authority. Pray with the consciousness that you are not begging. You are decreeing. You are declaring. You are legislating from the court of heaven. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before your throne of grace this morning. We come with boldness, not because we are righteous in ourselves, but because the blood of Jesus has given us access. We stand on the finished work of Calvary. We stand on the victory of the resurrection. We stand on the authority of the name of Jesus, the name that is above every other name, the name at which every knee must bow in heaven, on earth, and under the earth. Lord, we invoke your presence this morning. We invite the Holy Spirit to take charge of this prayer session. Let every distraction be silenced. Let every interference from the kingdom of darkness be paralyzed. Let the angels of God surround every believer participating in this prayer right now. Father, your word says in Psalm 68:1, "Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered." Lord, we are crying out to you this morning. Arise. Arise against every unseen enemy. Arise against every spiritual conspiracy. Arise against every wicked council that has gathered in the night season to plan evil against your children. We declare that you are the God who neither slumbers nor sleeps. You are the God who watches over your word to perform it. You are the God who is faithful to your covenant. And your word says in Deuteronomy 28:7, [music] "The Lord shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face, they shall come out against thee one way and flee before thee seven ways." Father, every enemy that has risen against us, whether [music] from the kingdom of darkness, whether from the realm of witchcraft and wizardry, whether from ancestral altars, whether from marine covenants, whether from evil monitoring spirits, whether from wicked neighbors, whether from envious colleagues, whether from jealous family members, whether from territorial spirits. Lord, we decree that they are smitten before our face. We declare that they came out against us one way, but they shall flee before us seven ways. We declare confusion in their camps. We declare division among their ranks. We declare that their weapon shall turn against them. We declare that the trap they set becomes the trap that consumes them in the name of Jesus. Every arrow that has been fired from the kingdom of darkness, we decree that it backfires. Every incantation, every enchantment, every divination, every spell, every curse, every hex, every manipulation from witchcraft, we break it by the blood of Jesus. We nullify it by the authority in the name of Jesus. We render it powerless and ineffective. We decree that no weapon formed against us shall prosper. And every tongue that rises against us in judgment, we condemn. This is our heritage as servants of the Lord and our righteousness is from you, oh God. Father, there are enemies [music] we can see and there are enemies we cannot see. But your word declares in 2 Kings 6:16, "They that be with us are more than they that be with them." Lord, we pray that you open our eyes to see into the spirit realm. Open our eyes like you open the eyes of Elisha's servant to see the mountain full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. Let us see that the angels of the Lord are encamped around us. Let us see that we are surrounded by divine protection. Let us see that no evil can come near our dwelling. Let us understand that we are seated with Christ in heavenly places far above all principality and power and might and dominion. God arise. Arise and defend me against the spirit of delay. Every demonic assignment to postpone my destiny to frustrate my efforts to cancel my breakthroughs. Lord, we command it to be destroyed by fire. We declare that what the enemy [music] delayed is being released now. We declare acceleration. We declare that the years the cankerworm has eaten are being restored. We declare that the time of waiting is over. We declare that this is our season of manifestation. We declare that the promises of God over our lives are coming to pass speedily. We declare Isaiah 60-22. [music] A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time. Lord, hasten your word in our lives. Let there be supernatural speed in the fulfillment of your promises. Father, arise and defend me against every household enemy. There are enemies from the household who know your name, who know your family, who know your secrets, who know your weaknesses, [music] and they have used that information to work witchcraft against you. The Bible says in Micah 7-6, "A man's enemies are the men of his own house. Lord, we cry out to you. Defend us against household wickedness. Every evil covenant walking from our father's house, we break it by the blood of Jesus. Every ancestral altar speaking against our destiny, we decree that it is destroyed by fire. Every family pattern of failure, poverty, sickness, untimely death, marital failure, mental disorder, we break it. We disconnect from it. We are the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. We are new creations. Old things have passed away and all things have become new in the mighty name of Jesus. Every evil gathering in the night season against our lives, we scatter it. Every coven, every witchcraft meeting, every satanic council where our names are mentioned, Lord, arise and scatter them. Let them be confused like the builders of the tower of Babel. Let their tongues be divided. Let their plans be frustrated. Let their power be broken. Let their altars be destroyed. SEND YOUR CONSUMING FIRE and burn up every altar where evil sacrifices have been offered against us. Send your angels with swords of fire to cut down every tree that our heavenly father has not planted. Let every evil plantation in our lives be uprooted and destroyed. God arise. Arise against marine spirits. There are evil spirits operating from the waters, from oceans, rivers, seas, lagoons, and they have been assigned against the glory of many people. They trouble marriages. They attack finances. They bring strange dreams. They manipulate destinies. They cause spiritual husband and spiritual wife problems. But we decree this morning that every marine covenant is broken. Every marine spirit [music] assigned against our lives, WE BIND YOU. WE CAST you out. We command you to go back to where you came from and never return. We cover ourselves with the blood of Jesus. We plead the blood of Jesus over our marriages, over our children, over our businesses, over our homes. And we declare that no marine spirit has any legal right or access to our lives. Father, your word says in Psalm 35:1, "Plead my cause, oh Lord, with them that strive with me. Fight against them that fight against me. Lord, we are asking you to plead our cause. There are people who are fighting us for no reason. There are people who hate us without a cause. There are people who are envious of the grace upon our lives. There are people who are jealous of our progress. There are people who want to see us fail, who want to see us suffer, who want [music] to see us in shame. But Lord, we are calling upon you to arise and fight against them that fight against us. TAKE HOLD OF shield and buckler and STAND UP FOR OUR HELP. Draw out also the spear and stop the way against them that persecute us. Say unto our souls, I am thy salvation. Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after our souls. Let them be turned back and brought to confusion that divise our heart. Let them be as chaff before the wind, and let the angel of the Lord chase them. Let their way be dark and slippery, and let the angel of the Lord persecute them. For without cause have they hid for us their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for our souls. Let destruction come upon them at unawares. Let their net have hid catch themselves into that very destruction. let them fall in the name of Jesus. Every pit [music] that has been dug for us, we decree that our enemies fall into it. Every trap that has been set for us, we decree that it catches those who set it. Every evil plan, every wicked scheme, every [music] satanic agenda, we decree that it backfires. We declare Esther 710 that Haman shall hang on the gallows that he prepared for Modcai. We declare that the stone the enemy rolled toward us is rolling back toward them seven times faster. We declare that the enemy shall eat the fruit of their own devices. We declare that what they meant for evil. God is turning around for our good. God arise and defend me against spiritual blindness. There are enemies assigned to blind your spiritual eyes so that you cannot see what God is doing. There are spirits of confusion sent to make you misunderstand the season you are in. There are spirits of doubt sent to make you question the promises of God. But we decree this morning that every veil of blindness is torn. Every scale of spiritual blindness falls off our eyes like it fell off the eyes of Saul on the road to Damascus. We receive spiritual clarity. We receive spiritual discernment. We receive the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Christ. The eyes of our understanding are enlightened. We see clearly. We perceive accurately. We discern correctly. WE KNOW THE TIMES and the seasons. We know what God IS DOING. WE ARE NOT CONFUSED. WE ARE not deceived. We walk in divine understanding. Father, there are satanic surveillance systems monitoring your children. There are evil eyes watching, waiting for an opportunity to strike. There are monitoring spirits assigned to study our movements, to know our schedules, to understand our patterns, so they can attack at our most vulnerable moments. But Lord, we declare that every evil eye monitoring our lives is blinded. We decree Isaiah 54-17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. Every evil eye looking at us for evil, we command you to catch fire. Every satanic telescope, every demonic binocular, every witchcraft camera, we destroy it by the fire of the Holy Ghost in the mighty name of Jesus. We cover ourselves with the blood. We apply the blood of Jesus over our homes, over [music] our cars, over our businesses, over our families, over our children, over our finances, over our health, over our destiny. The blood speaks better things than the blood of Abel. The blood of Jesus [music] speaks mercy. The blood of Jesus speaks protection. The blood of Jesus speaks victory. The blood of Jesus speaks deliverance. And we declare that by the blood of Jesus we overcome. By the blood of Jesus we are more than conquerors. By the blood of Jesus we have been redeemed from the curse of the law. By the blood of Jesus we have access to the throne of grace. By the blood of Jesus. Satan and all his demons are defeated. God arise. Arise against spiritual imprisonment. There are people whose destinies are locked up in the spirit realm. There are people whose blessings are caged. There are people whose testimonies are being held hostage by the enemy. But we decree this morning that every spiritual prison is broken. We invoke the power of the resurrection. The same power that rolled [music] away the stone from the tomb of Jesus, we release that power against every stone blocking our way. We declare that every chain is broken, every gate of brass is shattered, every bow of iron is cut in pieces. We walk out of every prison. We walk out of every limitation. We walk out of every bondage. We are free. We are delivered. We are liberated. Whom the son sets free is free indeed. Father, your word declares in Romans 8:31, "If God be for us, who can be against us?" Lord, we stand on this word this morning. We declare that you are for us. You are not against us. You are on our side. You are fighting for us. You are defending us. You are protecting us. You are blessing us. You are promoting us. You are advancing us. And if God be for us, it doesn't matter who is against us. It doesn't matter how many witches and wizards gather. It doesn't matter how many evil altars are erected. It doesn't matter how many curses are pronounced. They shall not stand. They shall not come to pass because the greater one lives in us. Because the God who is with us is greater than all the gods of the enemy. In the name of Jesus, every spirit of failure will bind you. Every spirit of poverty will cast you out. Every spirit of sickness will command you to go. Every spirit of confusion will rebuke you. Every spirit of fear will reject you. Every spirit of depression will destroy your whole. Every spirit of addiction will break your power. Every spirit of lust will command you to leave. Every spirit of anger will bind you. Every spirit of pride, we humble you. We declare that the spirit of the Lord is upon us. [music] The spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord. We are filled with the Holy Ghost. We are controlled by the Holy Ghost. We are led by the Holy Ghost. We are empowered by the Holy Ghost. God arise. Arise as our shield and our defender. Arise as our protector and our strong tower. Arise as our deliverer and our salvation. Arise as our healer and our provider. Arise as our vindicator and our justifier. Arise and let your enemies be scattered. Arise and let them that hate you flee before you. Arise and defend us against every unseen enemy. Arise and fight our battles. Arise and give us victory. Arise and give us dominion. Arise and establish your kingdom in our lives. Arise and manifest your glory through us. Arise and let the world see that you are God. Arise and let the enemy know that they cannot touch the anointed of the Lord. Arise and defend your children. We thank you, Father, because we know that you have heard us. We know that you have answered us. [music] We know that you are arising on our behalf even now. We know that angels have been dispatched. We know that demonic assignments have been cancelled. We know that evil altars have been destroyed. We know that wicked councils have been frustrated. We know that satanic plans have been aborted. WE KNOW THAT THE VICTORY IS OURS.
